prompts.background: Use case photorealistic-natural. ONE high-resolution photographic landscape, wide 3:2 canvas matching a 1920x1248 desktop scene composition. Calm first-person human eye level, fixed natural 35mm lens, level horizon. Soft natural illumination, realistic texture, moderate contrast and saturation, no HDR, no fantasy glow. A continuous believable space with a clearly visible route from bottom center toward a stopping place near x=50%, y=48%. This is a BACKGROUND PLATE for later multi-plane FFmpeg camera parallax: keep the central view open, do not include large close framing objects at the edges since these are separate layers. The image must fill every edge with scenery. No people, bodies, animals, signs, buildings, text, logos, watermarks, collage or panels. High mountain setting WITHOUT snow: blue-gray rocky peaks far away, layered misty mountain valleys, sparse mountain grass, warm gray stone, early morning soft gold light from upper LEFT. Camera is on a wide SAFE LEVEL mountain trail on gently rolling terrain, not a cliff edge. A modest broad path leads from foreground toward a grassy viewpoint looking across the valley. Distant peaks are stable landmarks, atmospheric perspective, no sheer drop at the feet, no aerial drone view.
prompts.middle: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY the lighting, texture, palette and eye-level perspective reference. Generate ONE independent middle-near parallax layer on a genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Full wide 3:2 landscape canvas aligned with reference. Draw ONLY two groups of warm gray, weathered natural mountain boulders with small patches of moss and low grass. Confine them to the LOWER outer LEFT 20% and RIGHT 17% of the frame, reaching at most 35% up from the bottom, grounded beyond the bottom edge; the middle and all upper areas are transparent. Match the reference with soft sunlight from upper LEFT, natural material detail and moderate contrast. Preserve CENTRAL 60% of width as completely transparent from top to bottom for an open pathway. No backdrop, no ground plane, no solid-color background, no fake checkerboard, no vignette; every pixel except actual objects is transparent. No people, animals, text, logo, watermark or collage. One cutout plate ready to composite over the reference, not a rendering of a finished combined scene.
prompts.near: Use case photorealistic-natural compositing. Reference image 1 is ONLY a lighting, color and photographic texture reference. Generate ONE closest foreground layer with actual RGBA alpha transparency, wide 3:2 full canvas. Draw ONLY a few tufts of low mountain grass, tiny alpine plants and dry seed heads growing from beyond the bottom outer corners. Only occupy the bottom 22% and outer 18% on each side, with the central pathway completely clear; no boulders. Lighting matches reference: warm soft morning light from upper LEFT and natural gentle shadows. Everything above the lower corner foliage and the central 60% corridor must be completely transparent, not a blurry backdrop. Fine natural edges, no ground plane, no filled background, no solid color, no painted checkerboard, no vignette, no whole scene, no collage. No person, animal, text or watermark. Match the realism of the reference and keep the near plants modest so that they will slide outward as the viewpoint moves forward.
